blocks.html: Wiring for operation and control of mechanical smoke removal systems shall be connected ahead of the main disconnect in accordance with the New York City Electrical Code and be protected against interior fire exposure to temperatures in excess of 1,000°F (537.8°C) for a period of not less than 15 minutes.
